derivation: The Gauge (OW24-2 stage G1), the Transposer and the Resonance Rod (stage G2) and the Echo Sounder (stage G4) moved here from SimpleBuilding with their rows unchanged: copper, a clock and an amethyst shard with SimpleBuilding's Copper Core, sold by the toolsmith. The Transposer: iron core, iron rods and an ender pearl, sold by the toolsmith. The Resonance Rod: iron core, iron rod, nugget, redstone and an amethyst shard, sold by the toolsmith. The Echo Sounder: a recovery compass, an enderite core and seven enderite nuggets, sold by the wandering trader (tier 5, one in ten visits). The Detector and the Attractor (stage G3) moved with their rows unchanged: the Detector from a recovery compass, echo shards, a calibrated sculk sensor and a gold core, the Attractor from an iron core, iron rods, redstone and lapis, both sold by the toolsmith.
